_about: Tools T-191 (Jared, 2026-11-24: Code Mode has to be an option in Settings that can be turned off). The admitted row code.execution.code-mode would otherwise fall to its subgroup's default section, Containers > Building & publishing images, between the Compose rows. It is a fine control over how a model uses tools, so it sits in AI & Providers > Models > How models answer, straight after Think between tool steps.
